guardrail.note: Applied by the runtime as Converse's guardrailConfig, from the guardrail id and version infra sets in the environment. Principle II names guardrails as part of the GenAI layer.

tools.name: governance-read
tools.description: Read-only governance lookups through the platform HTTP API. Every operation is a GET; the agent principal is refused on every other method (FR-056, R-602). Under AgentCore these are Converse tool calls served inside the runtime by agents/runtime/main.py; the allowlist module is unchanged..

info.title: Digest governance reads
info.description: A deliberately small surface. Each operation is backed by an endpoint specs 002-005 already ship; an operation needing a new data path is a spec change, not a definition change.
